literal: And giving and pleasant words if one practices, by piled-up relatives to be surrounded one will undergo.
translation: If one practices both generosity and pleasant speech, one will be surrounded by an ever-growing, multi-layered circle of relatives.
modern: கொடைத் தன்மையையும் இனிய சொற்களைப் பேசுதலையும் ஒருவன் கடைப்பிடித்தால், அவன் பல அடுக்குகளாகப் பெருகிய சுற்றத்தாரால் சூழப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet explains how a person can gather and retain a large, supportive circle of relatives and friends. The two essential qualities required are generosity (கொடுத்தல்) and speaking sweet, pleasant words (இன்சொல்). If a person consistently practices these virtues, their relatives will gather around them in multiple, closely-knit layers (அடுக்கிய சுற்றம்). The image of 'piled-up' or 'layered' relatives suggests an abundant, protective, and ever-expanding circle of kin who stand by the individual.
